newsitem.title: USA: Miami air cargo volumes edge up in March.
newsitem.headline: Miami air cargo volumes edge up in March.

text.p: Cargo volumes were up only slightly at Miami International Airport in March, with domestic cargo dropping, according to statistics obtained from the Dade County Aviation Department on Thursday.
"We expect domestic cargo to be essentially flat for the rest of the year," said MIA spokesman Hernando Vergara.
"But in international cargo, we expect it to continue its historical growth," he added.
Total cargo, including mail, was 162,105 tons, up 1.45 percent from the year ago, the statistics said.
International cargo, including mail, reached 131,222 tons, up 3.48 percent from March 1996.
Domestic cargo amounted to 30,883 tons, down 6.33 percent from the same month a year earlier.
For the first quarter of 1997, all cargo totalled 454,280 tons, up only 0.26 percent from the first three months of 1996.
